mapper.sql: AND ( N.TITLE ILIKE '%' || #{like} || '%' ESCAPE '\' OR N.BODY ILIKE '%' || #{like} || '%' ESCAPE '\' OR (',' || N.TOPICS || ',') ILIKE '%,' || #{like} || ',%' ESCAPE '\' )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_BRAIN_NOTE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT N.ID AS "id" ,N.KIND AS "kind" ,N.TITLE AS "title" ,N.TOPICS AS "topics" ,LEFT(N.BODY, 300) AS "body" ,TO_CHAR(N.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "updatedAt" FROM T_BRAIN_NOTE N WHERE 1=1 AND N.USER_ID = #{userId} AND N.KIND = #{kind}
ORDER BY N.UPDATED_AT DESC, N.ID DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT N.ID AS "id" ,N.KIND AS "kind" ,N.TITLE AS "title" ,N.BODY AS "body" ,N.TOPICS AS "topics" ,TO_CHAR(N.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "createdAt" ,TO_CHAR(N.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "updatedAt" FROM T_BRAIN_NOTE N WHERE N.ID = #{id} AND N.USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_BRAIN_NOTE (USER_ID, KIND, TITLE, BODY, TOPICS) VALUES (#{userId}, #{kind}, #{title}, #{body}, #{topics})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM T_BRAIN_NOTE WHERE ID = #{id} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
